usage.text:
The 1 kg weight falls onto one end of the seesaw at 0.66 s, swinging that end down and throwing the initially resting 100 g ball upward from the other end. The ball leaves the seesaw at 0.71 s and reaches a peak height of 3.25 m at 1.37 s.

It started at 0.85 m, so it rises **2.40 m above its starting height**, exceeding the required 50 cm. It then lands on the floor and comes to rest before the run ends. The world meets the brief.
